card.name: Mixed spots in clinical and dictionary text
card.fires_on: Mixed spots: the slash inside dictionary pronunciation entries, linking words after diagnosis or identification, and partway through words like arrhythmia or resuscitation.

modes.label: Dictionary pronunciation slash
modes.description: A slash right after a medical term is repeated and syllabified in a dictionary-style entry.

modes.label: Linking word after diagnosis
modes.description: 'and' or 'to' after diagnosis, identification or ECG, before management or treatment terms.
modes.example: Early identification<< and>> management of immune-mediated adverse reactions are essential

modes.label: Inside heart or resuscitation words
modes.description: Partway through long cardiac or emergency-care words.
modes.example: To minimize the risk of induced arr<<hythm>>ia, patients initiated or re-initiated

card.writes: It lowers words for doctors and patients, mostly in Chinese, so it adds little clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on a scattering of medical text spots with no single shared theme, such as dictionary entries and phrases about diagnosis and treatment.
